targets.authors: Mueller, P. A., & Oppenheimer, D. M.
targets.title: The pen is mightier than the keyboard: advantages of longhand over laptop note taking.
targets.evidence_quote: We conducted a direct replication of Mueller and Oppenheimer (2014) and extended their work by including groups who took notes using eWriters and who did not take notes.
targets.outcome_quote: Some trends suggested longhand superiority; however, performance did not consistently differ between any groups (experiments 1 and 2), including a group who did not take notes (experiment 2). Group differences were further decreased after students studied their notes (experiment 2).
targets.outcome_reasoning: The abstract states the original longhand superiority claim and that the present experiments do not consistently show group performance differences. Trends alone are not framed as replicated findings; central superiority is not supported. Full-text details and original experiment numbers unavailable.
